blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present a provably distortion-free semantic watermarking algorithm that requires only black-box sampling access to a generative model and black-box access to a semantic embedding. A watermark is called distortion-free if, averaged over its secret detection key, it leaves the generator's output distribution unchanged; this provides a formal guarantee that watermarking does not reduce output quality. Conventional such watermarks are often brittle to transformations. This is especially problematic for images, where benign operations such as compression, cropping, or resizing change the entire pixel representation. Semantic watermarks therefore require detection to be robust to content-preserving transformations. Previous methods combining these properties rely heavily on specific white-box properties of the underlying model: either to autoregressive text generation or to diffusion-specific access, such as control of the initial noise or diffusion inversion. In contrast, our construction is fully generic: It only interacts with the generative model and the semantic embedding, a function that determines the notion of "preserving content" under which detection should be robust, via sample and query access. We then instantiate this framework for image generation. We characterize the two competing properties required of the semantic embedding: it should remain stable under transformations that preserve an image's content, but should distinguish independent generations from the same prompt. We train an image encoder directly for this tradeoff. The resulting encoder improves separation while maintaining stability over off-the-shelf alternatives and enables strong aggregate detection while remaining robust to various transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our watermark scheme on both open-source and closed models, which is possible only due to restriction to black-box access.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个可以证明的无扭曲的语义标记水算法,它只需要黑盒采样访问基因模型和黑盒访问语义嵌入. 如果在它的秘密检测密钥上平均,使生成器的输出分布保持不变,那么一个水印就被称为无扭曲;这为水印不会降低输出质量提供了正式的保证. 这种传统的水印往往难以改变。 这对图像来说尤其有问题,在图像中,压缩,裁剪等良性操作或再大小改变整个像素代表. 因此,语义性水印要求检测对保存内容的转变具有强力。 以前结合这些属性的方法在很大程度上依赖于基础模型的特定白框属性:要么是自相递回的文本生成,要么是扩散特定的访问,如控制初始噪声或扩散倒置. 相反,我们的建筑是完全通用的: 它只与基因模型和语义嵌入相互作用,这个函数决定了"保留内容"的概念,在这个概念下检测应该很强,通过样本和查询访问. 然后,我们立即将这个框架用于图像生成。 我们描述语义嵌入所需的两种相竞属性:在保存图像内容的变相下,它应该保持稳定,但应该区分独立世代与同一瞬间. 我们直接为这个交易训练一个图像编码器。 由此产生的编码器改进了分离,同时保持了现成替代品的稳定性,并能够进行强聚检测,同时保持强能进行各种转换。 我们展示了我们的水印计划在开源和封闭模型上的有效性,这只有在限制黑箱访问的情况下才有可能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generative models can produce large amounts of text and images for which the original source is difficult to determine. Watermarking addresses this problem by embedding a signal that can later be detected using a secret key. Such a signal can be used to reliably attribute content to a particular model or service.
blocks.zh: 基因模型可以产生大量的文字和图像,而原始来源难以确定. 水标记通过嵌入一个以后可以用密钥检测到的信号来解决这个问题. 这种信号可用于可靠地将内容归属于特定模型或服务.

blocks.en:
A watermark should not noticeably degrade the model’s output. Christ et al. (2024) introduced a theoretical framework to guarantee the preservation of quality via the notion of cryptographic undetectability: without a (secret) watermark detection key, no efficient observer should be able to distinguish watermarked outputs from ordinary model outputs; in particular, no benchmark may show any degradation.
A weaker variant of the above notion is distortion-freeness, under which the marginal distribution of a (single) watermarked output, averaged over the secret key, is identical to the original output distribution.
This approach was subsequently adopted in practical systems. DeepMind introduced a configurable distortion-free version of SynthID-Text and deployed it in Gemini ( Dathathri et al., 2024 ) . Anthropic later adopted a version of SynthID-Text for Claude ( Anthropic, 2026 ) .
The resulting deployments illustrate an important advantage of distortion-free watermarking: the quality-preservation guarantee circumvents reevaluation for every benchmark or class of prompts.
blocks.zh:
水印不应明显降低模型的输出。 Christ等人(2024年)引入了一个理论框架,通过密码学的不可探测性概念来保证质量的保存:没有(秘密的)水印检测密钥,任何高效的观察者都不应该能够将水印输出与普通模型输出区分开来;特别是,任何基准都不能显示任何降解.
上述概念的一个较弱的变体是失真自由,在这个变体下,一个(单)水标输出的边缘分布,平均在密钥之上,与原始输出分布完全相同.
这种做法后来在实际系统中被采用。 DeepMind引入了可配置的无扭曲版本SynthID-Text,并将其部署在双子座(Datathri等人,2024年). Anthropic后来为克劳德采用了合成ID-Text(Anthropic,2026)的版本.
由此而来的部署说明无扭曲水标记的一个重要好处:质量保护保证绕过对每一基准或每类提示的重新评价。

blocks.en:
Distribution preservation, however, does not guarantee another ideal property of watermarking: robustness to edits.
A watermark may be detectable in the original output but disappear after the output is slightly modified.
The problem with editing is highly relevant for images.
Even mundane operations such as JPEG compression, cropping, resizing, or applying a filter can change essentially the entire pixel representation of the image.
A watermark tied directly to that pixel representation may therefore disappear even though the content of the image remains the same.
This motivates semantic watermarking, in which detection should be robust to transformations that preserve the content represented by the image.
blocks.zh:
然而,保存分布并不能保证水标记的另一个理想属性:对编辑的稳健性.
水印可能在原始输出中可探测,但在输出稍作修改后消失.
编辑的问题与图像高度相关.
即使是JPEG压缩,裁剪,再大小,或应用过滤器等普通操作,都可以从根本上改变图像的整个像素表现.
因此,与该像素代表直接相连的水印可能会消失,即使图像的内容保持不变。
这激发了语义性水标记,其中检测应强烈到能够保存图像所代表的内容的转换.

blocks.en:
Watermarking the semantic meaning of a model’s output is also arguably far more robust to watermark removal attempts. Usually, some of the semantic components of an output are requested in the prompt, but some of them are randomly chosen by the model during generation.
An adversary that only sees the output does not know which semantic components were inherent to the prompt and which were not, so they should not be able to remove the model’s semantic choices without possibly degrading the intended meaning of the output substantially.
This comes in sharp contrast to syntactic attacks, such as paraphrasing of sorts, that completely change the syntax without hurting the intended meaning of the output.
blocks.zh:
标注模型输出的语义意义, 通常,一个输出的一些语义组件是在即时请求的,但有些是模型在生成过程中随机选择的.
仅看到输出的对手并不知道哪些语义成分是即时的固有成分,哪些不是,因此他们不应能够去除模型的语义选择,而不会大大降低输出的预期含义。
这与综合攻击形成了鲜明的对比,例如类的比喻,这种攻击完全改变了语法,同时又不影响输出的预期意义.

blocks.en:
Existing semantic watermarking methods typically rely on specific “white-box” properties of the underlying generation process.
For text, this is less restrictive because many models share an autoregressive token-by-token interface.
Image watermarks, on the other hand, often require control over a particular diffusion latent space or noise distribution, as well as a model-specific inversion procedure.
Such access is unavailable through closed image-generation APIs and any change in the generation architecture may render the watermark scheme inapplicable.
blocks.zh:
现有的语义水标记方法通常依赖于基础生成过程的具体“白箱”特性。
对于文本来说,这限制较少,因为许多模型共享一个自动递归的逐键符号接口.
另一方面,图像水印往往要求控制特定的扩散潜在空间或噪声分布,以及特定模型的反演程序。
通过闭合的图像生成API无法使用这种访问,生成架构的任何改变都可能使水印方案不适用。

blocks.en:
We introduce the first watermarking framework that is simultaneously distortion-free, semantically robust, and uses only black-box access with respect to both the generative model and the semantic embedding, making it applicable to general generative models.
We access the generative model only as an oracle that returns independent samples and the semantic embedding only as an oracle that maps a completed output to a vector, without assuming how either oracle is implemented.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了第一个水印框架,它同时是无扭曲的、精密的,并且只使用黑盒进入基因模型和语义嵌入,使之适用于一般基因模型。
我们访问基因模型只是作为返回独立样本的甲骨文,而语义嵌入则只是作为将已完成的输出映射到矢量的甲骨文,而不假设两个甲骨文是如何执行的.

blocks.en:
Our algorithm samples several candidate outputs, maps them to semantic codes depending on their semantic embeddings, and selects one using a secret keyed function.
By accounting for the number of candidates that received each code, we ensure that the selected output has exactly the generator’s original marginal distribution when averaged over the key and the algorithm’s randomness.
This holds for every generator and semantic embedding.
If an edit preserves the semantic representation, the watermark is likely to survive (Appendix F ).
We prove these guarantees for any two oracles, without requiring a particular embedding architecture or model architecture.
This generality comes at a cost: single-output detection has a non-negligible false-positive rate and limited true-positive rate. This limitation is inherent to black-box output selection: selecting among N N independent candidates gives single-output detection rates satisfying TPR ≤ N ​ FPR \mathrm{TPR}\leq N\,\mathrm{FPR} (Appendix K.1 ). We therefore focus on settings where multiple outputs can be attributed to the same source, such as images uploaded by one social-media profile or assignments submitted by one student. Aggregating the watermark detection scores across this batch of outputs enables high-confidence detection.
blocks.zh:
我们的算法对几个候选输出进行抽样,根据它们的语义嵌入来将其映射到语义代码,并使用密钥函数选择一个.
通过计算每个代码的候选人数量,我们确保所选产出在平均于键和算法的随机性时,完全具有生成器的原始边际分布。
这代表每个生成器和语义嵌入。
如果编辑保留语义表述,水印很可能存活下来(Appendix F.
我们为任何两个甲骨文证明这些保证,而不需要特定的嵌入式建筑或模型建筑.
这种笼统性是有代价的:单产出检测有不可忽略的虚假阳性率和有限的真实阳性率. 这个限制是黑盒输出选择所固有的:在N独立候选人中选择,给予单输出检测率满足 TPR QQ N FPR\mathrm{TPR}\leq N\,\mathrm{FPR} (附录 K.1 ). 因此,我们侧重于多种产出可归属于同一来源的设置,如一个社交媒体简介上传的图像或一个学生提交的任务。 将水印检测分数汇总到这批产出中,就可以进行高自信检测。

blocks.en:
To apply our framework to images, we need a semantic embedding that distinguishes different images generated from the same prompt, while remaining stable under edits that preserve an image’s content. Standard semantic encoders may intentionally treat such independent generations from the same prompt as similar because they depict the same high-level concept.
For watermarking, however, we need to observe the variation among the generated outputs that remains distinguishable after editing. Otherwise, selecting one output rather than another cannot introduce a detectable semantic watermark.
This requires randomness in the meaning of the generated content itself, beyond randomness in its pixel representation; we call this semantic entropy and derive a lower bound on our algorithm’s detection probability in terms of this entropy.
We train an image encoder specifically to distinguish outputs generated by the same model from the same prompt using different random seeds, while keeping each image close to edited versions of it.
We compare the resulting encoder with existing image embeddings, evaluating both its stability under content-preserving transformations and its ability to distinguish independent generations across several image-generation models.
blocks.zh:
要将我们的框架应用于图像,我们需要一种语义嵌入,区分不同生成的图像与同一提示,同时在保存图像内容的编辑中保持稳定。 标准语义编码器可能有意将这种独立的几代人从与类似人相同的即时处理,因为它们描绘的是相同的高级概念.
然而,对于水标记,我们需要注意编辑后仍可区分的所产生的产出之间的差异。 否则,选择一个输出而不是另一个输出不能引入可探测的语义水印.
这需要生成的内容本身的意义的随机性,超出其像素表示的随机性;我们称之为这种语义式的 en,并从这个 en论的角度得出我们算法的检测概率的下限.
我们专门训练一个图像编码器,用不同的随机种子来区分同一个模型产生的输出和同一个提示,同时使每个图像接近其编辑过的版本.
我们把由此产生的编码器与现有的图像嵌入物进行比较,评价其在内容保存转换下的稳定性,以及区分几个图像生成模型的独立世代的能力。

blocks.en:
We evaluate detection from individual images and batches, robustness to common transformations, image quality, and same-prompt diversity. With 32 32 candidates, we obtain an AUROC of 0.920 0.920 for one image and 1.000 1.000 for ten.
Even when reusing a fixed key, our method achieves the lowest FID relative to unwatermarked generations among the evaluated methods, while retaining essentially the same Vendi diversity.
We also apply our framework to OpenAI’s closed GPT Image API, using only sampling access, and obtain an AUROC of 0.978 0.978 for batches of five images with eight candidates per output.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are therefore: 1. We give a black-box, distortion-free semantic watermarking framework for general generative models, requiring only sampling access to the generator and a semantic-embedding oracle. 2. We characterize how the semantic encoder affects detection. We use semantic entropy to quantify the encoder’s ability to distinguish independent generations from the same prompt, and prove a lower bound on the true-positive rate that increases with semantic entropy. 3. For diffusion-image generation, we train an encoder and evaluate image quality, same-prompt diversity, detection, and robustness to content-preserving transformations.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的主要贡献是: 1. 我们为一般的基因模型提供一个黑盒无扭曲的语义标记水框架,只要求取样进入生成器和一个语义嵌入的甲骨文。 2. 我们描述语义编码器如何影响检测。 我们使用语义 en来量化编码器区分独立世代的能力与同一瞬间的能力,并证明在语义 en增加的真实阳性速率上有较低的约束. 3. 为了传播-图像生成,我们培训一个编码器,并评价图像质量、同一瞬间的多样性、检测和稳健性,以便进行内容保存转换。

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early language-model watermarks embedded statistical signals during autoregressive generation. Kirchenbauer et al. (2023) promoted a keyed subset of tokens during decoding. Later work strengthened the distributional guarantees: Christ et al. (2024) formalized cryptographic undetectability, Vaikuntanathan & Zamir (2026) introduced bundle sampling that exactly preserves the output distribution, Kuditipudi et al. (2024) used Gumbel-based sampling, and Bahri & Wieting (2026) obtained distortion-free watermarking using only sampled text, and observed that shared meanings among candidates may weaken the watermark. MUSE selects among samples from black-box tabular generators but is not distortion-free ( Fang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 早期语言模型水印在自动递归生成过程中嵌入统计信号. Kirchenbauer等人(2023年)在解码过程中推广了密钥子集的令牌. 后来的工作加强了分配保障: 基督等传. (2024年) 正式的密码不可探测性,Vaikuntanathan & Zamir (2026年) 引入了精确保留输出分布的捆绑采样,Kuditipudi等人 (2024年) 使用基于Gumbel的采样,Bahri & Wieting (2026年) 仅使用采样文本获得失真无水标记,并观察到考生之间的共有意义可能会削弱水标记. MUSE从黑盒表型发电机样本中选择,但并非无扭曲(Fang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Preserving the output distribution does not ensure robustness to edits. Robust text schemes withstand substitutions and paraphrasing, including a construction based on pseudorandom error-correcting codes ( Kuditipudi et al., 2024 ; Christ & Gunn, 2024 ) . Semantic methods make the signal depend on meaning: SemStamp uses locality-sensitive hashing, k-SemStamp uses clustering, and PMark considers multiple channel constraints ( Hou et al., 2024a ; Hou et al., 2024b ; Huo et al., 2026 ) . These methods exploit autoregressive decisions; ours scores outputs, aggregating evidence across independent generations.
blocks.zh: 保留输出分布并不能确保编辑的稳健性. 强有力的文本方案能够承受替代和解释,包括基于伪随机误差校正代码的构造(Kuditipudi等人,2024年;Christ & Gunn,2024年)。 语义方法使信号依赖于意义: SemStamp使用局部敏感散列,k-SemStamp使用集群,Pmark考虑多个通道限制(Hou等人,2024a; Hou等人,2024b;Huo等人,2026年). 这些方法利用自发性的决定;我们的评分是产出,汇集独立世代的证据。

blocks.en: Image watermarking has largely relied on diffusion internals. Tree-Ring inserts Fourier patterns into the initial noise, while Gaussian Shading maps watermark information to Gaussian latents ( Wen et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) . Gunn et al.’s image construction uses pseudorandom error-correcting codes for multi-query undetectability and distinguishes Gaussian Shading’s single-image guarantee from fixed-key reuse, where they report reduced same-prompt diversity ( Gunn et al., 2025 ) . T2SMark adds per-generation randomness to relax fixed-codeword restrictions ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . These methods require access to the initial noise, which is typically unavailable through image-generation APIs, and diffusion inversion for detection. NoisePrints avoids inversion but requires the generation seed ( Goren et al., 2026 ) . We instead select among completed outputs.
blocks.zh: 图像水标记主要依靠传播内部. 树环插入 Fourier图案进入最初的噪声,而Gaussian Shading将水印信息映射到Gaussian潜伏物(Wen等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年b). Gunn等人的图像构造使用伪随机误差校正代码进行多清不测,并将高斯沙丁的单图像保证与固定键复用区分开来,他们报告说,同时出现的多样性降低(Gunn等人,2025年)。 T2SMAK增加了每代随机性,以放松固定编码词的限制(Yang等人,2025年). 这些方法要求访问最初的噪音(通常通过图像生成API无法使用),并传播反演以进行检测。 NoisePrints避免倒置,但需要生成种子(Goren等人,2026年). 我们选择已完成的产出。

blocks.en: Images also make the motivation for semantic watermarking clear: a watermark should survive pixel-level changes that preserve content, but not changes to the content itself. Reprompting attacks expose the latter risk by generating different content that retains the original watermark ( Müller et al., 2025 ) . SEAL encodes caption-derived information in the initial noise ( Arabi et al., 2025 ) , although captions may omit appearance or composition. SemBind learns prompt-consistent codes ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while SLICE separates semantic factors ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . We instead use direct image representations that remain stable under content-preserving edits yet distinguish independent same-prompt generations, without modifying or inverting generation.
blocks.zh: 图像还使语义水标记的动机清晰:一个水印应该活过保存内容的像素级变化,而不是内容本身的改变. 重复攻击通过生成保留原始水印的不同内容来暴露后者的风险(Müller等人,2025年)。 海豹突击队在最初的噪音中编码了字幕来源的信息(Arabi等人,2025年),尽管字幕可能会省略外观或组成。 SemBind学习了即时一致的代码(Zhang等人,2026年),而SLICE则分离了语义因素(Gao等人,2026年). 相反,我们使用在保留内容编辑下保持稳定的直接图像表示,却区分独立的同时代,而不修改或倒置生成。

blocks.en: Distortion-freeness imposes an inherent entropy requirement. If a prompt deterministically produces one output, any distortion-free scheme must return it, making watermarked and nonwatermarked outputs indistinguishable. More generally, Christ, Gunn, and Zamir showed that the detection power of distortion-free watermarking is necessarily tied to generation entropy ( Christ et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en:
Semantic robustness creates a stronger limitation: a generator may have high output entropy while producing outputs equivalent under the chosen semantics. For example, the same scene viewed from slightly different viewpoints.
A robust semantic representation should map them to one semantic region, leaving no variation from which to introduce a detectable signal. We therefore require sufficient variation in the semantic representations of outputs sampled from the same model and prompt. We refer to this variation as semantic entropy . The definition below quantifies this variation at a chosen semantic resolution.

blocks.en: The semantic embedding determines both detection power and robustness. Detection power grows with the semantic entropy of the generated outputs (Theorem 4 ), and robustness depends on whether an edit keeps an image close to its original representation in the semantic space (Appendix F ). Our framework is not specific to images or to a particular embedding architecture. For our image instantiation, however, the embedding must satisfy two complementary requirements: an image and its content-preserving transformations should remain close in the embedding space, while independent same-prompt generations should remain distinguishable.

blocks.en: However, the chosen representation must also distinguish independent same-prompt generations. Most semantic encoders are designed to separate images associated with different concepts or prompts, rather than different generations of the same prompt. Yet changing the random seed can substantially alter content and composition even when the prompt remains fixed ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . We therefore train the encoder to capture these instance-level differences.
blocks.zh: 然而,选定的代表也必须区分独立的同时代。 大多数语义编码器的设计是为了分离与不同概念或提示相关的图像,而不是同一提示的不同世代. 然而,即使速率保持不变,改变随机种子也可能大幅度改变内容和组成(徐等人,2025年)。 因此,我们培训编码器,以记录这些实例层面的差异。

blocks.en: Figures 3 and 4 in Appendix G illustrate the representation requirements and training pairs: transformations of one image should preserve its representation, whereas an independent same-prompt generation may receive a different representation. Existing representations are not explicitly optimized for both requirements: CLIP emphasizes image–text alignment, DINOv2 invariance across augmented views, and TPIPS perceptual similarity. We therefore fine-tune DINOv2 with a contrastive objective that treats content-preserving transformations as positives and different-seed generations from the same prompt as negatives. Appendix G provides architecture and training details.

blocks.en: 7 Experiments and Results

blocks.en:
We conduct the watermarking experiments using Stable Diffusion 2.1 ( Stability AI, 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) and COCO-2017 prompts ( Lin et al., 2014 ; Chen et al., 2015 ) held out from semantic encoder training.
Our black-box method selects among complete candidate images. Because sampling-based watermarks primarily target language while image methods typically access the generation process, no directly comparable image-watermarking baseline shares the same sampling-only access model. We therefore compare with Tree-Ring ( Wen et al., 2023 ) , Gaussian Shading ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , and SEAL ( Arabi et al., 2025 ) , three closely related methods for watermarking diffusion-generated images. We evaluate all methods on a common generation backbone using each method’s native generation and detection procedures.
For representation analysis, we compare our encoder with DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and TPIPS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) on independent generations from SD2.1 and two FLUX variants ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) and content-preserving perturbations of real images.

我们的黑盒方法从完整的候选图像中选择. 由于以取样为基础的水印主要针对语言,而图像方法一般访问生成过程,因此没有可直接比较的图像-水印基线共享相同的只取样的获取模式. 因此,我们比较了树环(Wen等人,2023年),高斯沙丁(Yang等人,2024年b)和海豹突击队(Arabi等人,2025年)三种密切相关的水印扩散生成图像的方法。 我们利用每种方法的本地生成和检测程序,在共同的一代骨干上评估所有方法。

blocks.en: 7.1 Generation Quality and Diversity

blocks.en: Our distortion-free guarantee matches the original generator distribution after averaging over secret keys; it does not require each fixed key to preserve that distribution. Because deployment typically reuses one key across many generations, we empirically evaluate fixed-key quality and diversity. Prior work shows that fixed-key reuse can reduce same-prompt diversity for some initial-noise watermarking methods ( Gunn et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . We therefore measure fixed-key distributional deviation and same-prompt diversity; Appendix J.7 reports prompt alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们的无扭曲保证在平均超过密钥后匹配原始的生成器分布;它不需要每个固定的密钥来保存该分布. 由于部署通常在几代人中重复使用一个关键,因此我们实证地评价固定钥匙的质量和多样性。 先前的研究表明,固定键的再利用可以减少一些初始噪声水标记方法的相同瞬态多样性(Gunn等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年)。 因此,我们衡量固定键分配偏差和相同瞬间的多样性;附录J.7报告迅速调整。

To assess same-prompt diversity, we generate 60 images for each of 60 prompts and measure the relative Vendi Score in a frozen DINOv2-base feature space, independent of our semantic encoder. Each configuration uses an unwatermarked reference set with the same model, prompts, and sampling settings.

blocks.en: 8 Organization of the Appendices
blocks.zh: 8 附录的组织

blocks.en: We organize the appendices to provide the technical foundations, proofs, and additional experimental evidence supporting our results. Appendix A introduces the formal definitions and assumptions underlying our framework, while Appendix B provides the full algorithmic specifications. We then establish our theoretical guarantees. In Appendix C , we prove that our generation algorithm is distortion-free for any black-box generator and semantic encoder. In Appendix D , we show how increasing semantic entropy strengthens the detection guarantee. In Appendix E , we prove that aggregating independently generated outputs improves detection reliability by reducing detection errors exponentially. In Appendix F , we establish robustness guarantees for transformations that approximately preserve semantic representations.

blocks.en: To instantiate our framework for images, we train a semantic encoder that separates independent generations from the same prompt while remaining stable under content-preserving transformations. Appendix G describes the training procedure, and Appendix H evaluates the resulting representation. We show that our encoder achieves higher estimated semantic entropy than the evaluated alternatives across multiple image generators, while maintaining stability under common image transformations.

blocks.en: We further investigate the effectiveness and generality of our method through additional experiments. Appendix I provides the complete detection and robustness evaluation protocols used in experiments, additional results at low false-positive rates, and examples of image transformations. In Appendix J , we examine several design choices and extensions. We relate encoder similarity to watermark retention (Appendix J.1 ). To motivate our algorithmic and encoder choices, we compare our trained encoder against off-the-shelf alternatives and Gumbel sampling against other distortion-free selection rules (Appendices J.2 and J.3 ). We also compare how different embedding discretizers spread candidates across codes and preserve those codes under edits (Appendix J.9 ). We show that our encoder improves watermark detection and that Gumbel sampling achieves stronger detection than the alternative sampling rules we evaluate. We further demonstrate the flexibility of our black-box framework in two settings. First, by changing the semantic encoder, we can target different notions of robustness without modifying the watermarking algorithm (Appendix J.4 ). Second, we demonstrate that our method works with closed-API image generators without accessing their internals. In particular, our GPT Image experiment achieves an AUROC of 0.978 when aggregating five images (Appendix J.5 ). We also watermark text-to-audio outputs (Appendix J.6 ) and evaluate detection in batches that mix images from different keys or include unwatermarked images (Appendix J.8 ). Finally, we evaluate generation quality and prompt alignment under fixed-key reuse, finding the smallest measured distributional shift among the evaluated methods while maintaining nearly unchanged prompt alignment (Section 7.1 and Appendix J.7 ).

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10. 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced a black-box, distortion-free semantic watermarking framework
requiring only sampling access to a generator and query access to a semantic
encoder. Our analysis connects detectability to semantic entropy, while
experiments demonstrate aggregate detection and robustness to common
transformations without compromising generation quality or diversity. These
results establish semantic rejection sampling as a general black-box foundation
for generative watermarking. Stronger encoders and more efficient sampling
remain directions for future work.

blocks.en: We now prove the distortion-free guarantee stated in Theorem 3 . Our goal is to show that our watermarking algorithm preserves the original generator’s distribution after averaging over the secret key, regardless of the generator or semantic encoder. blocks.en:
We now analyze how aggregating multiple independently generated outputs
improves watermark detection. In Algorithm 2 ,
we introduced batch detection by averaging the keyed scores of multiple
images and comparing the result with a threshold. We show that this
aggregation reduces both false-positive and false-negative probabilities
exponentially with the batch size, provided the expected clean and
watermarked scores lie on opposite sides of the threshold.

blocks.en:
We now analyze how transformations that preserve semantic similarity affect
our watermark. An edit may change many pixels while leaving the image’s
semantic representation nearly unchanged. Since we assign watermark scores
to LSH codes, we want to understand when such transformations
preserve the original code and consequently its keyed score.

到 LSH 代码,我们想了解 当这种转换
保存原始代码并因此保存其按键分数。

blocks.en:
We show that the probability of preserving the hash code increases with the
cosine similarity between the original and transformed representations.
This provides a theoretical explanation for why our watermark can remain
detectable after content-preserving transformations.

blocks.en: I.2 Robustness Protocols and Results

blocks.en:
We evaluate robustness on 200 prompts in the single-image setting ( B = 1 B=1 ).
Starting from clean watermarked and unwatermarked images, we apply the same
transformation to both populations. The detector parameters δ \delta , r ham r_{\mathrm{ham}} , and τ \tau are fixed before applying the transformations
and are not recalibrated on edited images. For each transformation, we report
the edited TPR on watermarked images and the edited FPR on unwatermarked
images. We also report paired retention: the fraction of watermarked images
detected before transformation that remain detected afterward. This separates
robustness to an edit from the detector’s initial clean-detection rate. The
evaluation includes 20 settings spanning compression, appearance changes,
noise and filtering, cropping, and translation.

compression, resampling, photometric changes, and affine transformations,

blocks.en: K.2 Computational Cost and Early Candidate Selection
blocks.zh: K.2 计算费用和提前甄选候选人

blocks.en:
Our strongest configuration generates 32 complete candidates for every
released image. This cost may be prohibitive in large-scale or latency-sensitive
applications.
blocks.zh:

释放图像。 这种费用在大规模或长期敏感情况下可能令人望而却步
应用。

blocks.en:
Recent work suggests that earlier candidate selection may be feasible for image
diffusion models. Guo et al. (2026) show that intermediate denoiser
activations can predict final-image quality and allow unpromising trajectories
to be terminated early. Habibian et al. (2024) show that low-resolution
diffusion features carry semantic layout and can be reused across denoising
steps. These results do not establish that our final semantic code can be
predicted before generation is complete, but they show that relevant structural
and semantic information is available at intermediate stages.
blocks.zh:

传播模式. Guo 等人(2026年)表明,中间的denoiser
激活可以预测最终的图像质量,并允许没有希望的轨迹
将提前终止。 Habibian等人(2024年)显示,分辨率低
扩散特性带有语义布局,可在去诺中重复使用
步骤。 这些结果不能证明我们最后的语义代码是
预测到的世代是完整的, 但它们显示相关的结构
和语义信息可在中间阶段获得。

blocks.en:
A promising direction is to predict the final semantic code or keyed score from
intermediate features, discard unlikely candidates, and complete only promising
trajectories. Any such optimization must preserve the selection probabilities
required by Theorem 3 . Prediction errors may discard
trajectories that would have received high final scores, weakening detection
even when image quality is unchanged. A useful evaluation must therefore report
expected completed denoising steps and wall-clock latency together with
detection, image quality, and distribution shift. This would expose the full
computation–detection tradeoff rather than treating early termination as a
speedup in isolation.

blocks.en: K.4 Adaptive Removal and Forgery Attacks
blocks.zh: K.4 适应性清除和伪造攻击

blocks.en:
Our robustness evaluation considers non-adaptive appearance, compression,
geometric, and generative transformations. Figure 2 summarizes the resulting detection and retention rates, while
Appendix I.2 reports the individual settings, detector
configurations, and achieved false-positive rates.

blocks.en:
These experiments do not establish security against an attacker who
deliberately targets the encoder or detector. Because our score is bound to the
semantic representation of the final image rather than to diffusion-specific
latent noise, the method may be less susceptible to reprompting attacks that
transfer a watermark to semantically different content, as studied by Müller et al. (2025) and addressed by SemBind ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
This possibility has not been evaluated directly. An adaptive attacker may
instead attempt to cross encoder or hash boundaries while preserving apparent
content, remove a high-scoring code, or produce altered content that retains
the original score. Lemma 22 characterizes
non-adversarial behavior under representation similarity and should not be
interpreted as a security guarantee against such attacks.

blocks.en: K.5 Extension beyond Images
blocks.zh: K.5 图像之外的扩展

blocks.en:
The framework treats the generator as a sampling oracle and is not tied to a
particular architecture or output modality.

特定的架构或输出模式。

blocks.en:
Each new domain requires a semantic encoder that separates independent outputs
while remaining stable under the relevant content-preserving transformations.
Future work should determine whether such encoders provide sufficient code
occupancy for detection, whether their geometry supports robustness to
realistic transformations, and whether sampling enough candidates remains
computationally practical.
